summary: Comprehensive testing of Short Code Login feature for iOS bookmarks. All backend APIs and frontend flows working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: /api/auth/shortcode/{code} returns valid=true and company_name for valid codes
Backend: /api/auth/shortcode/{code} returns 404 for invalid codes
Backend: Short codes are case-insensitive (uppercase/lowercase both work)
Backend: /api/auth/shortcode-login returns token and user object
Backend: /api/auth/shortcode-login returns 401 for invalid codes
Backend: Token from shortcode-login can be used for authenticated requests
Backend: /api/auth/generate-permanent-link returns permanent_url and short_code
Backend: /api/auth/generate-permanent-link requires authentication
Backend: Regenerating link creates a new unique short code
Backend: /api/auth/my-permanent-link returns link info
Backend: /api/auth/my-permanent-link requires authentication
Backend: End-to-end flow: generate -> verify -> login works correctly
Frontend: /go/{code} route loads ShortCodeLoginPage
Frontend: Loading state shows 'Even geduld...' and company name
Frontend: Successful login redirects to /dealer dashboard
Frontend: User is authenticated after short code login
Frontend: PermanentLoginLink component displays in dealer dashboard
Frontend: Permanent URL is displayed in input field
Frontend: Copy button present and functional
Frontend: 'Nieuwe link genereren' button present
Frontend: Security warning 'Belangrijk' displayed
critical_code_review_comments: Short code implementation is secure - codes are 8 characters using uppercase letters and numbers (excluding confusing chars like 0, O, I, 1, L)
Short codes are stored in user profile and can be regenerated
Permanent URL points to production domain (motoimportbv.nl) but preview URL also works
Token from shortcode-login is a full session token (1 year for dealers)
Security warning properly displayed to users about not sharing the link
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing test dealer account
context_for_next_testing_agent: Short code login feature fully tested and working. Test dealer (zoektest@dealer.nl) has short code 6FKA8YMS. The permanent_url in API response points to production domain (motoimportbv.nl) but the preview URL (motordealer-2.preview.emergentagent.com) also works for the /go/{code} route.
